clue.text: New Australian jumper, and one from the 1940s

parts.note: something brand new is a baby, as in a baby version
a boomer is a large male kangaroo in Australia

explanation.surface: A newly arrived Australian kangaroo is compared with someone born in the post-war years.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jumper' tempts British solvers towards a sweater; here it is a kangaroo.
explanation.definitionFit: The post-war birth surge began in the late 1940s, so someone born then belongs to that generation.

clue.text: Endless free-for-all is fine in Glasgow

indicators.note: endless says the word for free-for-all loses its final letter

parts.note: a brawl is a chaotic fight in which everyone joins

explanation.surface: A Glasgow brawl that never ends is somehow deemed fine.
explanation.definitionFit: Braw is the Scots dialect adjective for good, fine or handsome.

clue.text: Got indignant — 'Born Free' was the first

parts.note: to rid is to free or clear
whoever was first led the field

explanation.surface: Someone takes offence at a claim that the film Born Free came first.
explanation.definitionFit: To bridle is to show resentment or anger, like a horse throwing up its head.

clue.text: Shrub that could yield a viable gun oil

indicators.note: could yield says the following words might be rearranged into something new

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A garden plant is apparently the source of a workable gun lubricant.
explanation.definitionFit: This climbing tropical plant with bright papery bracts is a woody shrub.

clue.text: Men condescended to be heard, getting admitted to church

parts.note: OR, other ranks, is the military abbreviation for ordinary soldiers

indicators.note: to be heard says the word is taken by its spoken sound

parts.note: deigned means condescended to do something

explanation.surface: Soldiers deign to be listened to and get let into a church.
explanation.definitionFit: Clergy are formally admitted to holy orders when consecrated by a bishop.

clue.text: Contemplating a share of money in general

indicators.note: share of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone is considering taking a cut of the money as a whole.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyeing something means looking at it thoughtfully, considering it, as when contemplating it.

clue.text: Miss a festive occasion

parts.note: a miss is a girl, informally a gal

explanation.surface: Someone fails to attend a celebration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Miss' reads as a verb; it is a noun meaning a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A gala is a celebratory public event or party.

clue.text: Fish and beer with girl who's married

parts.note: ale is a type of beer
a married woman is a wife

explanation.surface: A pub meal of fish and beer with a married woman.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a North American herring species that migrates up rivers.

clue.text: Masses sent millions to drop appraisal

indicators.note: to drop says the letter for millions falls lower down the word, as in a down light

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
M is the abbreviation for million or millions

explanation.surface: Church services despatched millions to a lower figure in some evaluation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to drop' moves the M of MASSESSENT from the front to later on in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: An assessment is an evaluation or judgement of worth, a close synonym.

clue.text: All the best gold rings perish

indicators.note: rings says the gold symbol encircles the other word

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold
to perish is to die

explanation.surface: Someone wishes luck as gold wedding bands fail.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are farewells: a goodbye wishing someone well.

clue.text: Gradually supplies wimps welcoming sustenance

indicators.note: welcoming says the word for wimps takes the other in

parts.note: drips are feeble, spineless people
feed is food or nourishment

explanation.surface: Weaklings are given food bit by bit.
explanation.definitionFit: To drip-feed is to provide something in small amounts over time, a metaphor from medical intravenous drips.

clue.text: Ephemeral success that's seen with a crepe suzette?

definitions.meaning: an idiom for something that shines briefly and then fails
the pancake is flambéed, so a burst of flame appears in its cooking dish

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom comes from old flintlock guns whose priming powder flared without firing; the brief triumph is the same.

clue.text: Girl Guides that could be stars of stage and screen?

definitions.meaning: read whimsically, girls who guide are women showing the way
the actresses taking the main female roles

explanation.definitionFit: Principal actresses take the main female parts; whimsically, women in front guide others.

clue.text: Acts for theatre with grudges

parts.note: rep is repertory theatre
to grudge something is to resent it

explanation.surface: Bitter performances on a theatre stage.
explanation.definitionFit: To act on someone's behalf is to stand in for them as their agent or spokesperson.

clue.text: Outrage after objective is put at risk

indicators.note: after says the word for outrage comes later than the word for objective

parts.note: an end is an aim or goal
anger is a feeling of outrage

explanation.surface: Public fury follows once a goal is jeopardised.
explanation.definitionFit: To imperil something is to expose it to danger, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Help out with game, oddly showing self-possession

indicators.note: out says the letters of help are put out of order
oddly says take the odd-numbered letters of the following word

explanation.surface: Helping out in a match calls for a cool head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges HELP into PHLE; 'oddly' keeps G and M from GAME.
explanation.definitionFit: Besides mucus, the word means calmness and composure, from the old humour thought to make people sluggish and unflappable.

clue.text: Shambles as police inspector arrives, going inside perhaps

parts.note: DI stands for Detective Inspector

indicators.note: going inside says the abbreviation for arrives is placed within the word for perhaps

parts.note: say means for example, perhaps
arr is the timetable abbreviation for arrives

explanation.surface: A messy scene as the detective turns up and maybe heads indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: A shambles is a state of chaos and complete disorder.

clue.text: Flinch from engineers with wind

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
to coil is to wind round

explanation.surface: Someone shies away from army engineers and the breeze.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wind' suggests a breeze; it is the verb that rhymes with 'find'.
explanation.definitionFit: To recoil is to spring back or shrink away in fear or disgust.

clue.text: First couple of pairs in line must be competent

indicators.note: in says the selected letters go inside the word for line

parts.note: a cable is a line or wire

indicators.note: first couple of says take the opening two letters of the next word

explanation.surface: Front pairs in a queue must be up to the job.
explanation.definitionFit: Capable means having the ability or skill to do something, the same as being competent.

clue.text: Prisoner found outside pub in the morning, kind of brown

indicators.note: found outside says the word for prisoner surrounds the rest

parts.note: a con is a convict
an inn is a public house
am stands for ante meridiem, before noon

explanation.surface: A convict is discovered outside a pub at dawn, looking a bit brown.
explanation.definitionFit: The colour named after the spice is a warm light reddish brown.

clue.text: Rome's worried about one hotel becoming addictive

indicators.note: about says the scrambled letters surround the numeral
worried says the letters of the city's name are shaken up

parts.note: the city's name with its S, rearranged
I is the Roman numeral for one
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: The Italian capital frets about a single hotel turning into a habit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worried' rearranges ROMES into MORES, and 'about' puts I inside it to give MOREIS.
explanation.definitionFit: Food so tasty you want more of it is informally called this, meaning compelling to keep eating.

clue.text: Drastic pay cut helps the Queen to get stand-in tutor

indicators.note: drastic suggests violent change, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the late Queen

explanation.surface: A severe salary reduction helps the monarch hire a temporary teacher.
explanation.definitionFit: A school teacher who covers for absent staff is a temporary replacement tutor.

clue.text: Dance beat gets green light

parts.note: to tan someone's hide is to beat them
a green light means go

explanation.surface: A dance rhythm gets approval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beat' suggests rhythm; it means to thrash.
explanation.definitionFit: A tango is a ballroom dance from Argentina.

clue.text: View reversed after female charges

indicators.note: after says the turned word follows the abbreviation for female
reversed says the word for view is read backwards

parts.note: to see is to view

explanation.surface: An opinion flips after a woman makes accusations.
explanation.definitionFit: Fees are payments asked for a service, i.e. charges.

clue.text: Simple task for head coach sacking leader

parts.note: nob is slang for the head

indicators.note: sacking leader says the word for coach loses its first letter

parts.note: a trainer coaches athletes

explanation.surface: An easy job for the chief coach: firing the captain.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal term for something so easy that it needs no thought at all.

clue.text: Excellent brief

definitions.meaning: to brief someone is to prepare them with information in advance

explanation.definitionFit: The word means top-quality, and as a verb means to prepare someone with information.

clue.text: Slough is building for storage

definitions.meaning: to slough is to cast off, as a snake does its skin
a simple hut for keeping tools and the like

explanation.walkthrough: Slough is also an English town, a red herring here.
explanation.definitionFit: Animals cast off skin or fur, and a garden hut stores tools; both senses share one spelling.

clue.text: Flower youth plans to develop

indicators.note: to develop says these letters change and grow into a new form

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A young person has plans to grow into a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a garden primula hybrid with clusters of bright blooms.
